title: terraform-google-bigquery-yaml configuration
description: YAML configuration consumed by the terraform-google-bigquery-yaml module. Map keys under datasets, tables, views, materialized_views, routines, connections and transfers are logical keys; each one is also the default resource ID. Tables, views, materialized views and routines are top-level sections whose entries name their dataset with dataset: <key under datasets>. The module reads the 'properties' of every definition below to reject unknown keys, so this file is the single source of truth for the configuration shape.

project_id.description: Default project for every resource in this file. Takes precedence over the module's project_id variable; a resource-level project_id takes precedence over this.

datasets.description: Datasets keyed by logical key (the default dataset_id). Tables, views, materialized views and routines are defined in their own top-level sections and reference a dataset by this key.

tables.description: Tables keyed by logical key (the default table_id). Each names its dataset with dataset: <key under datasets>.

views.description: Logical views keyed by logical key (the default table_id). Each names its dataset with dataset: <key under datasets>.

materialized_views.description: Materialized views keyed by logical key (the default table_id). Each names its dataset with dataset: <key under datasets>.

routines.description: UDFs, table-valued functions and stored procedures keyed by logical key (the default routine_id). Each names its dataset with dataset: <key under datasets>.

connections.description: BigQuery connections keyed by logical key (the default connection_id). Other entries can reference a connection by this key.

transfers.description: BigQuery Data Transfer Service configs (scheduled queries, Cloud Storage, S3, ...) keyed by logical key (the default display_name).

defaults.description: Values applied to every resource of a type unless the resource sets its own. Merging is shallow (a resource value replaces the default) except labels, which are merged, and datasets.access, which is prepended to every dataset's access list.

location.description: Default location for datasets, connections and transfers (e.g. US, EU, europe-west2).

labels.description: Key/value labels. Numbers and booleans are converted to strings.

deletion_policy.description: Provider-level deletion policy. PREVENT makes terraform destroy fail; ABANDON removes the resource from state without deleting it.

sql_type.description: A StandardSqlDataType. Either a simple type name (INT64, STRING, ...), a JSON string, or a mapping such as {typeKind: ARRAY, arrayElementType: {typeKind: STRING}}.

iam_binding.description: Grants one IAM role to one or more members (non-authoritative, one google_*_iam_member per member).

members.description: IAM members: user:, group:, serviceAccount:, domain:, principal://, principalSet://, allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers.

access_entry.description: Dataset access grant, implemented with google_bigquery_dataset_access (non-authoritative and compatible with authorized views).

role.description: OWNER, WRITER, READER, or an IAM role. roles/bigquery.dataOwner, dataEditor and dataViewer are normalised to OWNER, WRITER and READER.

members.description: user:EMAIL, serviceAccount:EMAIL, group:EMAIL, domain:DOMAIN, specialGroup:NAME, projectOwners, projectWriters, projectReaders, allAuthenticatedUsers, allUsers, iamMember:MEMBER, or a principal:// / principalSet:// identifier.

table_ref.description: A table or view: its key in this file ("orders"), "dataset.table" (a dataset key from this file or a dataset in the default project), "project.dataset.table", or a mapping.

dataset_ref.description: A dataset: "dataset" (a managed dataset key or a dataset in the default project), "project.dataset", or a mapping.

target_types.description: Resource types in the authorized dataset that get access. Defaults to [VIEWS].

routine_ref.description: A routine: its key in this file ("mask_email"), "dataset.routine" (a dataset key from this file or a dataset in the default project), "project.dataset.routine", or a mapping.

dataset_id.description: Dataset ID. Defaults to the map key.

project_id.description: Project of the dataset, and of the tables, views, materialized views and routines that reference it.

create.description: Set to false for a dataset that already exists outside this configuration. Nested tables, views, routines, access grants and authorizations are still managed.

location.description: Dataset location. Defaults to defaults.location (provider default: US).

delete_contents_on_destroy.description: Delete all tables when the dataset is destroyed. Defaults to false.

default_collation.description: 'und:ci' for case-insensitive collation, or "" to clear it.

authorized_views.description: Views (logical or materialized) allowed to query this dataset.

authorized_datasets.description: Datasets whose views are all allowed to query this dataset.

authorized_routines.description: Routines (e.g. table-valued functions) allowed to query this dataset.

connection.description: A connection key from this file, or a full connection name.

dataset.description: Key of the dataset (under datasets) that this table belongs to. Required. For a dataset managed elsewhere, declare it under datasets with create: false.

table_id.description: Table ID. Defaults to the map key.

schema.description: Inline schema: a list of fields, or a JSON string. Mutually exclusive with schema_file.

schema_file.description: Path to a JSON or YAML schema file (a list of fields), relative to the configuration file.

clustering.description: Up to four top-level columns, in priority order.

deletion_protection.description: When true (the provider default), Terraform refuses to delete the table.

schema_field.description: A BigQuery TableFieldSchema. Keys use the BigQuery API (camelCase) names.

field.description: Partitioning column. Omit for ingestion-time partitioning.

external_data_configuration.description: Makes the table an external table. Put the schema at table level (schema / schema_file); the module sends it where the provider expects it.

autodetect.description: Defaults to true when no schema is given, false otherwise.

connection_id.description: A connection key from this file, or project.location.connection_id.

biglake_configuration.description: BigLake managed (Iceberg) table stored in Cloud Storage.

connection_id.description: A connection key from this file, or a full connection name.

storage_uri.description: gs://bucket/path/ (must end with a slash; no wildcards).

dataset.description: Key of the dataset (under datasets) that this view belongs to. Required. For a dataset managed elsewhere, declare it under datasets with create: false.

table_id.description: View ID. Defaults to the map key.

query.description: View SQL. Mutually exclusive with query_file.

query_file.description: Path to a .sql file, or a .tftpl template rendered with template_vars.

dataset.description: Key of the dataset (under datasets) that this materialized view belongs to. Required. For a dataset managed elsewhere, declare it under datasets with create: false.

table_id.description: Materialized view ID. Defaults to the map key.

dataset.description: Key of the dataset (under datasets) that this routine belongs to. Required. For a dataset managed elsewhere, declare it under datasets with create: false.

routine_id.description: Routine ID. Defaults to the map key.

definition_body.description: For SQL functions, the expression inside AS ( ... ).

definition_file.description: Path to a file holding the body; .tftpl files are rendered with template_vars.

return_table_type.description: For table-valued functions: {columns: [{name, type}]} or a JSON string.

connection.description: A connection key from this file, or a full connection name.
A connection key from this file, or a full connection name.
Exactly one of cloud_resource, cloud_sql, aws, azure, cloud_spanner, spark or configuration must be present.

connection_id.description: Connection ID. Defaults to the map key.

cloud_resource.description: Connection backed by a Google-managed service account (BigLake, object tables, remote functions, Vertex AI). Write cloud_resource: {}

password_secret.description: Name of an entry in the module's secrets variable. Never put passwords in YAML.

connector_configuration.description: BigQuery connector framework (AlloyDB, Cloud SQL via connectors, ...).

password_secret.description: Name of an entry in the module's secrets variable.

data_source_id.description: scheduled_query, google_cloud_storage, amazon_s3, azure_blob_storage, dcm_dt, google_ads, ...

location.description: Defaults to the destination dataset's location when it is managed here, else defaults.location.

destination_dataset_id.description: A dataset key from this file, or a dataset ID.

query_file.description: Path to a SQL file (or .tftpl template) used as params.query.

params.description: Data-source-specific parameters. Values are converted to strings.

secret_access_key_secret.description: Name of an entry in the module's secrets variable (e.g. the AWS secret access key for amazon_s3 transfers).

template_placeholder.description: A ${...} placeholder, replaced when the module renders the file with templatefile().
